title: Dimensional Ring
description: Transport between Dimensions with the power of the Dimensional Ring!
body:
### Dimensional Ring Guidebook!

In order to get your very own ring, you can craft it:

![Crafting Recpies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e47c5cf07570d7f006d47704a722e0c7c9b4052.png)

Once acuring your own ring, right click to get a menu:

![menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/377f46ac4dc0c4df74db8570c143ddb05a1350c7.png)

This will show up in chat, and click any dimensions that you wish to go.

For custom dimension you've installed, you must first go to that custom one & upon entering it, it will now enlist the dimension in the menu.

### **RECOURSE PACK REQUIRED!**
You can find it alongside the datapack downloads.

# Q&A

**Why does it show <namespace>:<worldname>?** 

Due to how minecraft works & stores data, it does that.

**Why do I neeed to enter a custom dimension first?**

The datapack doesnt reconize the custom dimenisons that you've added, only knows of MC's default ones. IF you're setting up a server and want immediate acess for everyone: ``/execute in <namespace>:<name> run tp ~ ~ ~``

Any other questions:
Do join the discord server.
